logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of compounds was determined by measuring the octanol : water partition coefficient, log P, using a shake flask method, according to OECD.36 Deionized water and n-octanol were presaturated for 24 h under stirring. The stock solutions of the compounds were prepared by dissolving proper amounts in 25 ml of presaturated deionized water to a final concentration of 0.5 mmol · L-1.36 The samples were prepared by adding 7.5 ml of the stock solution plus 7.5 ml of presaturated 1-octanol and shaken for two hours. Then, they were centrifuged for phase separation. The aqueous phases (7.0 ml) were treated with an equivalent volume of aqua regia 50% (V/V) to remove all organic matter. The solutions were heated and concentrated to dryness. After drying the entire solution, the sample was calcined at 773,15 K for 20 min. A stock solution sample was measured to calculate the total amount of gold. For analysis, the material was solubilized in aqua regia 1.0% (V/V) and was analyzed in duplicate by ICP-OES, following the methodology adapted from Klose and colleagues.44 The partition coefficient P was calculated by the concentration in aqueous and organic phases and expressed as log P. The samples were prepared in duplicates and analyzed in two independent experiments.
